verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB presents itself as fully managed ClickHouse hosting, but it documents a BYOC deployment mode that runs inside the customer's own AWS or Google Cloud account. It also claims your data "never leaves your cloud or your hardware." That puts the product in user-controlled infrastructure, but there is no evidence of a self-installable, self-operated distribution of the core product. missing for 10: self-managed or on-prem installation docs, an open-source or downloadable distribution of the storage layer, clarity on who operates BYOC deployments, Azure or own-hardware BYOC details, independent corroboration.
